description: Vulnerability in Oracle TimesTen In-Memory Database (component: Kubernetes Operator).  Supported versions that are affected are 22.1-22.1.40.0 and  26.1-26.1.1.2.0. Easily exploitable vulnerability allows low privileged attacker with network access via HTTPS to compromise Oracle TimesTen In-Memory Database.  Successful attacks of this vulnerability can result in  unauthorized read access to a subset of Oracle TimesTen In-Memory Database accessible data. CVSS 3.1 Base Score 4.3 (Confidentiality impacts).  CVSS Vector: (CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:N/A:N).
